t: Gets away with that. Back of a length ball down leg. {batter} looks to help it away and misses.
Banged in short angling well across {batter} outside off stump. But that's way too wide. {bowler} has fallen in {his} follow-through and stays down.
Banged into the track and sliding just down leg. {batter} looks for the pull and gets beaten by the extra lift.
Banged in short outside off and this skips well over the bowler's head. {batter} swipes at it and misses.
Full toss down leg, {he} misses the flick
Full and darting down leg.
This was like a wide yorker to a rhb.
Floats this full delivery down the leg side
The full ball goes past the flick and down leg. Good stop by the keeper
Slower ball that goes wrong and slides well down leg.
Short and down leg.
Fuller and much wider outside off.
Bowls a cutter but loses {his} radar, too far wide outside off.
Yorker length and wide of off, while swinging away. Left alone by {batter}
Fired in on a length but way down leg.
{batter} confident it's a wide here. Was speared in full and past the wide marker.
No, given wide. Shortish down leg, {batter} swivelled and went for the fine pull
Full but way down the leg side.
{he} was interestingly attempting a yorker, and the length was not that bad but the line was down leg with some inswing
Banged in short on middle, but it's too high and called a wide
{he} stands with a bit of a room, and {bowler} goes short and wide of off. Left alone by {batter}, and it is called wide
Slower bouncer outside off but it veers away as {batter} leaves it.
Slower bumper on leg. {batter} watches the ball balloon over {his} head. Called a wide
Strays down leg side and concedes a wide
Goes for the wide yorker, but it goes outside the wide line
Angled in, and it goes on with the angle to land full and outside leg. It finishes wide, as {batter} looks to pull but misses
On a full length, but quite wide of off. {he} lets it go, and it is called wide
Banged into the track outside off and this balloons over the batter's head. Left alone by {batter} and called a wide
Full and wide down leg side, too wide for {batter} to connect with {his} swing
Umpires checking to see if this should be a No ball. The second bounce was just beyond the crease. Just a wide
Slower bumper outside off. {batter} looks for the upper-cut but seems to get beaten by the lack of pace.
Bangs it short, {he} ducks, and called wide.
Swings this in, and ends up bowling wide of leg.
Beats everyone! {bowler} fires it down leg, full as well.
Left alone and called a wide
Back of a length delivery that is fired down leg.
Fires a full ball down leg as {batter} gives charge
Back of a length ball down leg. {he} looks to help it away, can't connect but gets a wide.
Ahh, this is too high, and hence called wide! The keeper had to leap full stretch to take that, with {batter} swaying away at this bouncer on middle
Short and well outside off.
Short and way outside off.
{he} starts with a full ball outside leg. {batter} looks to flick but misses, and it is called wide
Landed very short just outside off and finished over the batter as {he} left
Full length angled into leg, and heading down, as {he} looked to clip but missed. Wide called
Full and angling in, but pitching outside leg. {batter} went sweeping, but missed
Bowls a yorker which is pretty wide of off. {batter} still went after it but missed, and it is called wide
Takes pace off as {he} bowls a slower length ball, but loses direction by spraying this way outside off, {batter} reaches out to cut but misses.
Slower bouncer outside off, but was way too short. Called a wide on height.
Slower one goes on the bounce to the keeper. Fullish ball landed well outside off and went away with the angle, let go
Short and well wide outside off, easy leave
In fact, it's too wide. Time to reload. {batter} let this one go quite early on
Tight call for wide goes in the batter's favour. Wide length ball, {batter} looks to slap it and misses
Down leg, swings further.
Looks to go for the wide yorker, but goes past the tramline
Yorker slips well down leg. Let go.
{bowler} tests out the middle of the track outside off and it responds much more than {he} expects.
Bumper from around the wicket angles down leg. {batter} shapes for the pull but lets it go
Banged in short outside off and this seems to balloon over the batter's head.
Banged in short outside off, {batter} has a swing at it but can't connect.
On a length, but too wide. {he}'ll have to rebowl that as well
Darted down leg. {batter} misses and the keeper parries it to short fine.
Short of a length, and outside leg. Du {batter} looked to clip but missed, and it is called wide
Back of a length delivery bowled a mile outside off.
Short and wide outside off. {batter} goes chasing after it and misses it completely
Beaten as {he} looks to cut, wide signalled
Called a wide. One bouncer for the over as well.
Pitches wide outside off and seams further away, {batter} lets it go
Goes right for the blockhole, but slides down leg side and to the keeper. Arms splayed by the umpires. Reload...
Zipped in very full and very wide outside off. {batter} looks to sweep and misses. Called a wide, much to the bowler's annoyance
Down leg, the shortish ball is let go after {batter} shaped to pull it
All three stumps were visible, so it would be wide on line. Ball's close to the edge of the front pad...
Teaser but line's wrong. Down leg, the slow length ball goes past the pull
Slower bouncer angled across {him}. {batter} even tried to get inside the line and swat it away bringing {his} bat from up to down, but can't connect. Called wide for height
Down leg. Fullish length ball goes past the attempted stand-up sweep
Of course. This is beyond the tramlines, so the wide is called.
{bowler} tries to hide it away but slants it down the wide marker. Time to reload
Easy wide to call
Fullish but shaping down leg.
Angles this across, and bowls this slower ball full and wide of off.
This should have been the penultimate ball of the game but {bowler} bowls a wide. Of course {he} does. Misses the mark with a wide yorker
Angling down leg on a length, {he} misses the flick
This is a wide, though. {he} goes full and pretty wide outside off, with {batter} leaving it alone
{he} sees {batter} hinting to get across, and bowls quite full and wide of off. Left alone, and wide called
Ohhh, this arrives ten sets of stumps outside leg. {bowler} bangs it short on leg after {he} sees {batter} make room.
Slower and fuller well outside off stump, and past the tramline. Called a wide
Slanted in full but also down leg. {batter} falls over trying to access it but does not lift {his} back foot. Called a wide
{his} head was outside off and {he} was falling away trying to hit it from down to up.
Speared in fuller but still outside the tramlines on the off side. {batter} shoulders arms and {bowler} will have to reload
Banged short but sliding down leg, {he} ducks under it
Back of a length ball down leg, {he} steps across and looks to scoop this fine. Can't connect but called a wide
{bowler} looks to take it away from {batter}'s arc and {batter} looks to push at it, but it's wide of the tramline
Sharp bumper on middle and leg, and this sails through. Above the batter's head, though, meaning a wide is called once {batter} swipes at thin air
Length ball angling across, but too wide across {batter}. Wide given
Backs away big time, but {bowler} spots this and lobs this well outside off. Ends up missing the tramline. Called a wide
Sharp bumper on off stump. Sails over the batter's head, though, and called a wide for height
Low full toss speared down leg.
Swings down leg. Late and sharp movement. {batter} danced down and looked to flick the length ball, tried to get it fine.
Goes yorker. Fires a low fully down leg, it goes past the attempted flick
Starts with a wide down the leg side. Some inswing too, so good signs
Bouncer beats the hook, given wide though.
Shorter side of a length, and wide of off. Left alone, and wide called
Short and wide outside off. Sneaks just beyond the tramlines and {batter} gets the wide {he} wants, having let it go
Comes around the wicket and bowls a juicy full toss wide outside off, {he} cannot reach it
Length delivery darted across the batter way outside off.
Keeping the ball out of {batter}'s arc. Fullish ball, much wider outside off stump. Left alone
Length ball speared well down leg.
Oh dear! Darted in a mile down leg, perhaps as a riposte to {batter} shaping for the reverse. {he} abandons that thought mid-way and gets the wide.
Full and wide outside off.
Dug deep into the pitch, spongy bounce and well outside off. Let go
Bowls a bumper, but it is called wide. Goes for a bouncer on middle, and the ball angles away way too high. {batter} lets it go
This is surely a wide, and it's given so. Short ball at a lack of pace on middle, and the ball shaped away to finish wide of off. {batter} let it go
Ducked under. Looked wide, not given.
Bumper over leg, let go. Called wide on height
Darted in way down leg.
Full and much too wide outside off, {batter} lets it go
Full ball down leg side, {batter} moves across and tries to glance but misses
Slower back of a length ball but quite high and is called a wide
Offcutter but that was down leg, called a wide.
Short delivery pitching on middle, and finishing outside leg as {he} looked to pull but missed. Wide called
Speared in a mile outside leg. Left alone and called a wide, unsurprisingly
Jammed in full but well down leg.
That was very wide outside off stump ... {batter} seems to have experienced some discomfort after completing that bat swing
Short and wide of off. {batter} goes ramping at it far away from {his} body, but misses. Wide called
Slower bumper outside off.
Full and wide and {batter} cannot connect. And it's been given a wide
Dug in short and it's deemed wide on height
Back of length delivery, this one slides down leg as well.
Length ball hung up wide outside off. {batter} throws the kitchen sink at it but still cannot make contact.
Length ball down leg, {batter} came down and missed a leg glance
Short of length, slower but too far wide outside off, {batter} lets it pass
On a back of a length and down leg.
Flatter and down leg, called a wide
Very short and very high outside off, called a wide
On a length and a mile outside off.
Bowls it very full and wide outside off, {batter} watches it through.
Bashed half-way down outside off and this balloons over the batter.
Sprays this a mile outside off. {batter}, having advanced, leaves it alone and gets the wide call
Slower one, slips from {his} hands and lands well wide of the tramline.
Decision overturned. Wide called!
Slower ball that goes awry and slides down leg.
Five wides to start
Slower bouncer outside off, {batter} waits on it to cut, but is beaten by the lack of pace.
Goes for the wide yorker but it is outside the tram line, {batter} lets it go, the free-hit carries over
Tossed up well outside off stump and past the tramline. Called a wide
Short and wide, {batter} flashes at it but can't connect
Shorter side of good length outside off and angled across. {batter} goes across to scoop but misses.
Bouncer attempted but the line is well outside off. Called a wide
Fuller angling well outside off stump past the tramline.
Spinning down leg, {batter} misses the flick but almost overbalances
Short ball outside off, tennis-ball bounce takes it over the head
Short ball but this too slides down leg.
Full ball swinging in, and landing outside leg. {he} looks to flick but misses. Wide called.
That was a length ball down leg, {he} steps across and eyes a scoop. Misses.
Short and wide outside off. {batter} swishes at it and misses. Called a wide too
Back of a length delivery sliding down leg.
Full down leg, called a wide
Short ball but too far down leg for {batter} to make contact with the pull
Into the pitch but that was well down leg. Called a wide.
Strays down leg side with an attempted yorker
On-pace bouncer aiming for {batter}'s body. That's a good bumper, but is called a wide.
Short and wide outside off, {he} thinks of the ramp but lets it be, wide called
Full and wide, too wide. {batter} can't make a connection with it. Called wide
Looks to go wide, but overdoes it. Well outside the wide line
Sprays the back of a length ball down leg, called a wide,
Back of a length wide outside off. {batter} swings like a rusty gate and to no one's surprise, misses.
Short and wide outside off.
{batter} swipes at it and only swats away a few flies in the process. Called a wide, though
Short, too short, and down leg side too, might be wide on two counts
Slower short ball outside off. {batter} jumps up onto {his} toes and swings hard at it.
Down leg, the length ball goes past the glance.
Flatter well outside off, just past the tramline. Called a wide.
Length ball sprayed way outside off.
Sliding down leg side.
{bowler} overdoes this as {he} goes wide of off.
Bowls a yorker, but too wide outside off even as {batter} was hinting to get across. Wide called
Banged in too short. Wide called immediately as {batter} watches it sail over {his} shoulder
Fires it on a length wide outside off, {he} leaves it be.
Down leg, not called wide.
Banged into the track and this sails over the batter's head. {batter} lets it go and that has been called a wide for height
{batter} steps out of {his} crease a bit too early, {bowler} bangs it in short of a length wide outside off and seams it away, far away from {batter} who had moved outside leg
Fires this full ball down leg
Pace off but that's down leg and they rush through for an extra run.
Oh dear - more runs! Banged in short outside off and this sails over the batter's head.
Slower bouncer on off, but shaping in to finish just outside leg. {batter} shaped to pull but then swayed out of the way
Seems to be above the batter's head, despite {batter} jumping up and the wide call stays!
Sprays it wide after spotting {him} charge down, {he} leaves it be and called wide
Fires this down leg.
Ball! This swings in and pitches full and outside leg. {he} looked to whip but missed
Fired across the batter outside off.
Angled down leg.
This is a wide, though!
Very wide and slow, the fullish ball is let go
Very full but also sneaking down leg.
Very full and wide of off, and left alone
Seemed touch-and-go, but leaning more towards being a wide
Length ball and this swings well down leg.
Shortish ball is slow and is let go. {batter} cleared the front leg and wanted to go leg side
Full ball down leg side
Oh dear - that is the worst ball to bowl at this stage! Darted in a mile outside leg.
This is a wide. {batter} lets it go as {bowler} bowls very full and wide of off
Zipped in very full but outside leg.
Flatter and waaay outside off, called a wide
Short and too wide outside off.
Oh dear - that is a huge wide! Even a leg slip might not have gotten to that. Full and a mile down leg. Shapes away further and ends up in a different postcode to the keeper!
Slower ball on a length but too wide outside off.
Darted in full but also down leg.
Ooh, that's a close call for wide, {bowler} tossed it up near the tram line outside off, {batter} had moved a touch towards leg and was too far away from the line to play a shot
Darted across on a length wide outside off. Left alone by the batter and called a wide
Short and sliding a shade down leg. {batter} gets inside the line and misses {his} swipe.
Banged in short outside off and this sails over the batter's head.
Slower ball, and outside leg.
{bowler} responds with a bouncer, but it's a wayward one. Flies down leg
Very, very wide length ball is let go. Not too far from going past the return crease
Goes on a length well outside off, {batter} shoulders arms. That was well outside the tramline
Back of length lands outside off and turns away sharply. No part of the ball is inside the imaginary line over the tramline.
Throws it well wide outside off, easy leave
Sprays a full toss down leg, {he} misses
Banged into the track outside off.
Speared in full but well outside off.
Well outside off
Might've landed outside the cut strip. Yep it did, but after going past the batter.
Full ball speared in well down leg.
Starts with a wide. On a short of a length on middle, and seaming in to finish outside leg. {batter} looked to nudge but missed
Slower bumper outside off and this balloons past the batter. Left alone by {batter} and called a wide
That's too wide outside off
Back of a length wide outside off and this swings away further.
Outside off. {bowler} floats this pretty full, and {batter} looks to drive, but misses.
Slower bumper just outside off, which is a riposte to {batter} advance.
Length ball well down leg, {he} flicks but misses
Very wide of off! {bowler} angles this across, and goes on a length wide of off. {batter} lets it go, as the ball shapes away further
Misses the line {batter} leaves it. Length ball from around the wicket, way too wide to make {him} play. {batter} didn't move in the crease
Slower bumper outside off. {batter} tries to force it through the off side but only swishes at thin air.
Down the leg side. Slower ball from {bowler}, but on a length, and way wide of off. {batter} lets that pass
Called wide immediately
Good length ball outside leg stump. {batter} charges down the track to pull but misses
Full toss lands outside the cut strip but well past the pitch. That's why it's just wide and not a no-ball. Let go of course
{batter} runs down the pitch, but the ball is sprayed well outside the wide crease
Ball. {bowler} bowls short and at a change of pace, but goes wide of off. {batter} lets it go, and the ball shapes away
Length ball spins away after landing well outside off. Let go
Very wide length ball, {batter} reaches out with {his} torso and looks to cut, beaten
Outside the wide crease.
Flatter and wider outside off to start, {he} misses the cut. Given as wide
{bowler} slips this down leg and it spins further away.
Dug in short, down leg and over the batter's head. Wide called
Back of a length outside off and this nips away.
Slower ball on a length way outside off. {batter} swings {himself} off {his} feet but the ball just does not arrive. Almost rolled along the turf too.
Bouncer outside off, and it's too short.
{batter} dances down early, so {bowler} went wide on a fullish length. Might've swung away a touch, let go
Angle on the yorker is sharp. Goes past the flick, down leg. Wide called. {batter} and {bowler} have a chat, likely whether if it brushed the pad.
{bowler} angles it in, and lands this as a yorker outside leg. {batter} looks to whip but misses
Starts with a wide! Bowls it on the shorter side, and outside leg. {batter} looked to swipe but misses
Back of a length ball swinging away from {batter} but well outside off stump. Called a wide
Slower bumper outside off and this seems to balloon over the batter's head.
Called wide. Thought there was a deflection but no.
This is a wild delivery. Short and wide outside off. Left alone by {batter} and called a wide
Bends {his} leg and pushes towards off to let the ball go down leg
Ball. {bowler} angles it in, and lands it full and outside leg. {batter} looked to flick but missed
Outside off. {bowler} floats this very full, and wide of off. {batter} lets it go
Goes for the wide yorker, but ends up pitching it outside of the tramline
Back of a length delivery way outside off. Called a wide.
Back of a length, angling down leg, can't connect with the tuck off the hip
Touch fuller. Lands on leg and slides down leg. {batter} raises {his} bat to let the ball go
Bowled from a low release wide outside off, {batter} gets beaten
For height. {bowler} bowls on a back of a length just outside off, and seeing the ball fly, {batter} lets it go
Darted across a mile outside off.
Low fully down leg. Goes past the flick
{bowler} goes for a legbreak on a length but it's quite wide and spins away even more. Called wide
Banged in short on leg and this balloons over the batter's head. Left alone and called a wide
Driven into a length, it goes down leg with the angle. {batter} tries to help it, misses
Gets the length ball a rip but it lands just pas the tramline outside off. Called a wide
{bowler} sees the batter coming at {him} and so bowls a wide one outside off, too wide though
{bowler} slides this full ball down the leg side.
Slower back of a length ball well outside the tramline outside off
Full ball well down leg, goes past the attempted whip that {batter} wanted to get fine
Goes for the yorker on the legs but it slides down leg as {batter} looks to flick. Second wide of the over
Length ball, but way wide of off.
Slides this full ball down leg
On a length, and very wide outside off. Left alone by {batter}, and it is called wide
{bowler} is feeling pressure. {he} goes very full and wide outside off, and {batter} leaves it alone
Very wide of off.
Sharp short ball but this is down leg. {batter} late on the pull and misses it. Called a wide, though
Yorker length as the ball swings away to land wide of off. {batter} lets it go
Bangs this one in short outside off, {batter} leaves it alone
Nicely done. Sharp short of a length ball on middle, {he} sways outside the line. That is called a wide for height.
Bouncer on leg, {batter} looks to ramp but misses. Called wide on height immediately.
Speared in full but also down leg.
Ball! Full and outside leg, and {he} missed as {he} looked to sweep
Turns away. Legbreak lands on a length but the starting line is wide and it's let go
Delivery. {batter} leaves it alone, as it is very full and wide of off
{bowler} angled this across, and bowled full and wide of off. {batter} left that alone, perhaps assuming that it would be a wide. It is given wide indeed
Gets the leg-stump yorker wrong and slides this a mile down leg.
{bowler} expects {batter} to make room, so {he} goes well down leg. Batter doesn't move.
Full and sliding down leg, {he} misses the click
Slanted in full and down leg.
Very wide outside off. {batter} happy to let it go and take the wide
Goes for the wide yorker but ends up bowling a wide full toss. {batter} tries to access it but cannot lay bat on ball.
Fullish ball doesn't swing, goes down leg. Past the flick, to the keeper. {bowler} might've been looking for the magic ball
Full ball going down the leg side
Good bounce but down leg. Length ball landed on leg and went past the leg glance
Full ball outside off. {batter} backs away, and ends up backing away too much. Can't meet the ball after reaching out
Pitched down leg side, and only slides further and further down leg and down to deep fine leg...
Goes down leg.
Looks to take it away from {his} arc, but ends up bowling a wide! {batter} reached out for it but it was too far away
Short and outside leg, and {batter} looks to pull but misses.
Hint of swing in but slips down leg, wide called
Fullish down leg and {batter} will also feel {he} missed out
Well outside off and called a wide
Sees {batter} shuffle across, goes wide, beats {him} outside off, and it is still called a wide despite {batter}'s movement across.
There is a check to see if this landed on the cut strip. Well inside, in fact, so it will just be a wide
Full and sliding down leg. {batter} has a swing at it and misses. Called a wide
Ball, but {he} has {batter} on {his} toes! Bangs it on a back of a length on off, and gets it to finish outside leg, with {batter} half-ducking at it
Full and slanted well down leg.
Shorter side of a length outside leg, and {batter} looked to flick but missed
Full ball, but very wide outside off stump. Left alone and they collect a wide run
Fullish and just outside leg. {he} went flicking but missed, and is called wide
Big turn but that was well outside off. Called a wide
Dug into the track and this slides down leg with the angle. {batter} gets inside the line and then watches it go through to the keeper
Strays down leg side with a fuller length delivery, {batter} steps across and swings but can't connect
{batter} sprawls to make {his} ground! Shortish and sliding down leg. {nonstriker} has a swipe at it and misses.
Oh {he} begins with a wide down leg side, dragged it down really short and is lucky to not get punished
Full and sliding down leg.
That was well outside the line
Down leg side, too far for {batter} to connect with the slog sweep
Short and way outside off. Left alone by {batter} and called a wide
Fullish and outside leg. Wide called, as {batter} looked to clip but missed
Goes full and wide but past the tramline
Low and full but down leg, {batter} doesn't move {his} feet and tries to shovel it fine. Misses.
Oh dear! Full and speared down leg.
Full and wide ball, beyond the tram-lines
{batter} goes deep in the crease and looks to flick, but the ball is too wide for {him}.
Darted in full and also darted down leg.
Length ball, flashed wide.
Spears it into the blockhole... but slanting far down leg side. {bowler} has to reload
Keeper happy but that's called wide. Turn working against {bowler}. Fullish length ball landed close to the tramline and was let go
No bat involved, and the wide stays!
Length ball swinging down leg.
Tight call for wide. Given.
Length ball down leg, {he} has a swing and misses. Called wide. {he} was eyeing the area over short fine leg
Banged into the track with more conviction but this sails harmlessly over the batter's head. Called a wide.
Down leg, beats the glance. Wide, but {batter} disappointed to not have put it
That'll be a wide.
Full and wide outside off, called wide for the line. Passed just outside the tramline
Dragged down outside leg, {batter} swivels to pull but it goes down for a wide
{bowler} misses {his} line and fires this down leg
Tries the cut in the end and misses. Called a wide as well
Angled away from the batter, and springs away from the wide marker too. {he}'s missing {his} lines here
Shortish and sliding down leg. {batter} swings at it and misses. Called a wide
Banged into the track and this slides down leg. {batter} swings at it and misses, and called a wide. Called one bouncer for the over too
Length down leg, called a wide
Oh, really wide. Way outside off and it's a wide for sure
Banged in short outside leg and this sails over {batter}'s head. Called a wide
Slower bouncer that goes awry and sails over the batter's head. Called a wide
Bowled wide outside off from over the wicket, just past the tram line and {batter} lets it go
Starts with a wide. {bowler} floats a slower ball on a full length wide of off, and {batter} lets it go
Slower ball, full and wide, {batter} leaves as it goes past the tramline
Short on off, {batter} looks to hook but is beaten. Called wide on height
Slower bouncer just outside off, spongy bounce takes it over head. Let go
Down the leg side.
Yep. Slower good length ball well outside off. {batter} took step to {his} right but the ball was comfortably outside the tramline
{bowler} misses {his} line looking to follow {batter}, who made room. The length ball slanted well down leg and went past the attempted heave
Was a shortish ball down leg that beat the pull.
Slower back of a length ball well outside off, {batter} throws {his} hands at it but can't reach it
Strays too much down the leg side for a wide
The slower bouncer is too high outside off, {batter} tries to upper cut but the ball is too far away
Outside leg. It was quite full, and angling in. {batter} looked to flick but missed
Slower ball pushed across the batter a mile outside off. {batter} tries to reach it by shuffling across but fails to do so. Called a wide nevertheless
Bouncer angling down leg, {he} goes for the pull but misses.
Angling away on a length, no feet movement as {he} slashes at it, beaten and called wide
Fires this full and down leg for a wide
Fires it full and down the leg side
Slower short ball bowled a mile outside off.
This ball swings in and lands full and outside leg. Short looked to flick, but the ball was too wide
{he} goes on a fullish length, and wide outside off. {batter} shapes to smash, but lets it go
Fired full and down leg for a wide
Slips one down leg, {batter} looks to nudge it fine but misses. Wide called.
Bashed in shorter outside off and this sails over the batter's head. Left alone and called a wide
That looked wide on first view.
Sends in a bouncer that goes well over {batter}'s head. Called a wide
Back of a length ball but well outside off stump. Called a wide
Bumps it short, and it's angled across. {batter} stays still and watches it go over {him} for a wide
Flatter down leg, {he} wants to go for a sweep and misses. Called a wide
Given wide in fact.
Outside leg. {bowler} bowls fullish and outside leg. {batter} looks to flick but misses
Change of plan. Wide yorker, but it's well past the tramline. {batter} stands still and lets it go
Full but way outside off
Short ball outside leg stump. Lets it go through and they take a wide run
